owner_requirements: gb_feedback_1445: ONE lever aimed at the 42/48 draw problem (draw-breaking objective/terminal reward or decisive tiebreak, my call); >=40/48 counting, >=24/48 with a winner, >=40/48 vs frozen v0.0.13, more-training-beats-less repeat, per-side reporting; own PR before the run; nice 19, host CPU <= 85%
gb_feedback_1350/1405: decisive-games floor in the criterion; the v0.0.13 regression (46/48 blocked) as a HARD gate
question: Does rewarding knockdowns (a head/torso hit after which the opponent falls first) turn v0.0.21-style bell draws against frozen v0.0.19 into decisive wins, without breaking play against v0.0.13, and does more training beat less?
lever: ONE change from the v0.0.21 recipe: the fitness bonus. v0.0.21: hit_and_stayed_up(500). v0.0.22: motor_gate.knocked_down - the candidate's first head/torso hit precedes the opponent's first fall, and the opponent falls before the candidate (first_scoring_tick < opponent_fall_tick < stand_ticks). Fitness = stand_ticks/3000 + 1.0 * knocked_down. Initialisation (v0.0.19 final_params - the last level-up, NOT the regressed v0.0.21), training opponent (frozen v0.0.19), model, ES settings, reset and ending (v2, unchanged) are as in v0.0.21.
why_this_lever: cycle-0030: all 42 v0.0.21 draws reached the bell with referee points [0,0] although the candidate landed head hits in every one; ending v2 decides by the first fall, so draws mean nobody was knocked down. A bell tiebreak on grokbot-classified hits was rejected: it would reward the feather taps jekko's referee does not score, i.e. move the ruler to make our policy win. Not dependent on referee points, so the referee-points feasibility probe is not a precondition for this lever (it remains an open finding for jekko).
classification: solo motor fitness against a frozen opponent (no match outcome in the fitness); diagnostic, not an unassisted boxing result
env: grokbot.scenarios.RangeBoxingEnv(separation_m=0.5, horizon_ticks=3000); unchanged jekko env; runs to the horizon (does not stop at the first fall)

training.method: grokbot.motor_gate.train antithetic ES with CRN, run as 16 + 32 iterations on one generator (identical to one 48-iteration call) so the @16 checkpoint is kept

gate.stance_pass: candidate stands (no persistent non-foot floor support) for the full 3000 ticks
gate.reach_pass: candidate lands >= 1 strike tick (approach and referee active speed >= 0.5 m/s on a strike target)
gate.also_reported: scoring_reach_rate (share of trials with >= 1 head/torso hit); not part of the primary gate
gate.note: motor gate vs gen4, reported (not gating)

primary.name: vs frozen v0.0.19 on NEW seeds 13000-13023 (48 games), checked in order

head_to_head.env: grokbot.reference_env.ReferenceEndingEnv(RangeBoxingEnv(separation_m=0.5, horizon_ticks=3000), anti_stalling=True) via grokbot.selfplay.play_game (ending v2, unchanged)
head_to_head.candidate: the trained v0.0.22 GroupPDPolicy, eval noise 0.05
head_to_head.opponent: frozen v0.0.19: kind group_pd, v0.0.19 final_params, eval noise 0.05
head_to_head.sides: each seed with the candidate in corner A and in corner B (48 games)
head_to_head.valid: grokbot.selfplay.valid_result; every game stays in the denominator
head_to_head.elo: Elo = 400*log10(p/(1-p)) with p = (1+mean)/2 clipped to [0.5/n, 1-0.5/n]; Elo lower bound from p_low = (1+lower95)/2 (-inf if p_low <= 0); win rate with a Wilson 95% interval (descriptive)

order: 1. VALIDITY: valid games (selfplay.valid_result) >= 40/48, else verdict VALIDITY_FAILED (fail loud: non-zero exit, later criteria not evaluated)
2. DECISIVENESS: decisive games (valid wins + valid losses, i.e. not draws) >= 24/48, else verdict DECISIVE_FAILED (fail loud)
3. (b) Hoeffding lower95 > 0 and (c) >= half of the candidate's valid wins with >= 1 candidate head/torso hit; else CRITERION_NOT_MET; both pass -> PRIMARY_PASSED

hard_gate_v0013.opponent: frozen v0.0.13 (punch, punch_params(gen4, onset=-3, duration=0, amplitude=2)), eval noise 0.05

monotonicity.pass: for each: valid >= 40/48 first, then Wilson 95% lower bound of the more-trained side's win rate over valid games > 0.55 (same rule as the v0.0.21 addendum)

level_up: tag v0.0.22 iff primary verdict PRIMARY_PASSED AND hard_gate_v0013 passes AND both monotonicity matchups pass

secondary_reported_not_gating.baseline: v0.0.19 self-mirror on the primary seeds
secondary_reported_not_gating.vs_v0016: candidate vs frozen v0.0.16 on seeds 14000-14023
secondary_reported_not_gating.motor_gate: candidate and v0.0.19 (re-run, checked per trial against its committed summary) vs gen4
secondary_reported_not_gating.reporting: every head-to-head split by the stronger side's seat with wins / losses / draws / no-contests / blocked / engine faults counted separately

red_team_notes: knocked_down needs the opponent to fall; v0.0.19 fell first in only 4/48 of v0.0.21's primary games, so the bonus may be rare early in training (sparse signal)
the stand term still rewards the candidate standing; a policy that pushes the opponent over by body contact could earn knockdowns only if it also lands a head/torso hit before the fall
no game has been played on seeds 13000-15023; smoke tests use seeds >= 99980
pre_declared_readings: LEVEL_UP: tag v0.0.22; next preregister a self-play league seeded from it (decisive games now exist)
VALIDITY_FAILED or DECISIVE_FAILED: knockdowns were not learned; report knockdown_share; next lever: knockdown shaping on the opponent's trunk tilt after a hit
CRITERION_NOT_MET: decisive but no superiority; report seat split
hard gate or monotonicity fails: no tag; name the failing matchup
